title: Supervise one long-running experiment
objective: Ensure one compile, profiler, torchrun, or serving experiment terminates with cleanup and an explicit disposition.
preconditions: A command that may spawn children or exceed an interactive turn
steps: Choose a justified wall timeout and kill grace period
Launch through testbench/bin/supervise.py or the supervised run.sh
On timeout, verify the process group and GPU allocations are gone
Record complete, no-go, invalid, or genuinely blocked

acceptance.pass: The command finishes or times out with no surviving child and one terminal record.
acceptance.invalid: Workers, GPU memory, or goal state remain active without an owner.

stop_rule: Do not leave an experiment running implicitly between agent sessions.
origin_evidence: The session corpus contained stranded precompile, child-process, paused, usage-limited, and stale active work.
